create_ReadoutBlock: create a ReadoutBlock instance with global, GNN, and regularization config objects
run_ReadoutBlock_forward: run the ReadoutBlock forward pass with graph data, node features, and edge features
build_global_readout: build a global readout using feedforward networks and normalization on graph-scattered node features
build_node_readout: build a node readout by applying residual feedforward and normalization to node features
build_edge_readout: build an edge readout by applying residual feedforward and normalization to edge features
